title: Obesity, morbid obesity and BMI
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's weight diagnosis and BMI, if reportable.

describe.none: The provider does not diagnose or address weight; the BMI appears only in the vitals.
describe.obesity: The provider diagnoses obesity and addresses it (diet and activity counseling).
describe.morbid_obesity: The provider diagnoses morbid obesity and addresses it (diet, activity, referral to a weight management program).

describe.32: The vitals list a BMI of 32 point something (write it as 'BMI 32.' plus one digit), and no other BMI value.
describe.37: The vitals list a BMI of 37 point something (write it as 'BMI 37.' plus one digit), and no other BMI value.
describe.42: The vitals list a BMI of 42 point something (write it as 'BMI 42.' plus one digit), and no other BMI value.
describe.52: The vitals list a BMI of 52 point something (write it as 'BMI 52.' plus one digit), and no other BMI value.

bmi_without_dx.description: Reported a BMI code without a provider-documented weight diagnosis.

obesity_from_bmi.description: Coded obesity from the BMI alone; the provider must diagnose it.

morbid_from_bmi.description: Upgraded the provider's 'obesity' to morbid obesity from the BMI.

missed_morbid.description: Coded obesity, unspecified when the provider documented morbid obesity.

missed_bmi.description: Left out the BMI code when it is reportable.

rules.explain: Morbid (severe) obesity documented by the provider: E66.01 (HCC 48).

wrong.why: The provider documents morbid obesity: E66.01, not E66.9.

rules.explain: Obesity documented by the provider: E66.9. The coder does not upgrade it to morbid obesity from the BMI.

wrong.why: Only the provider can diagnose morbid obesity; the BMI does not change the diagnosis.

rules.explain: No weight diagnosis by the provider: nothing to code.

wrong.why: Obesity must be diagnosed by the provider, not inferred from the BMI.

rules.explain: A BMI without a weight diagnosis by the provider is not reported: Z68 codes need an associated reportable diagnosis.

wrong.why: BMI codes are reported only with a provider-documented weight diagnosis such as obesity.

rules.explain: A BMI without a weight diagnosis by the provider is not reported: Z68 codes need an associated reportable diagnosis.

wrong.why: BMI codes are reported only with a provider-documented weight diagnosis such as obesity.

rules.explain: A BMI without a weight diagnosis by the provider is not reported: Z68 codes need an associated reportable diagnosis.

wrong.why: BMI codes are reported only with a provider-documented weight diagnosis such as obesity.

rules.explain: A BMI without a weight diagnosis by the provider is not reported: Z68 codes need an associated reportable diagnosis.

wrong.why: BMI codes are reported only with a provider-documented weight diagnosis such as obesity.

rules.explain: BMI 32.x with a provider weight diagnosis: add Z68.32.

wrong.why: The BMI is documented and the provider diagnosed the weight condition: add the Z68 code.

rules.explain: BMI 37.x with a provider weight diagnosis: add Z68.37.

wrong.why: The BMI is documented and the provider diagnosed the weight condition: add the Z68 code.

rules.explain: BMI 42.x with a provider weight diagnosis: add Z68.41 (BMI 40 or more maps to HCC 48 on its own).

wrong.why: The BMI is documented and the provider diagnosed the weight condition: add the Z68 code.

rules.explain: BMI 52.x with a provider weight diagnosis: add Z68.43 (BMI 40 or more maps to HCC 48 on its own).

wrong.why: The BMI is documented and the provider diagnosed the weight condition: add the Z68 code.
